QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] A Closed Book
QuestInfo.0: Who is pulling the strings in the Mushroom Castle invasion? Speak with Eremos about it.
QuestInfo.1: You've discovered the Vikings that invaded Mushroom Castle have a leader. Stop the invasion quickly by defeating their leader.
QuestInfo.2: When you confronted him, you discovered the Viking leader has a soft side. Love is the true equalizer.
